release_notes:
FocusShield v1.5.0 — Anti-Slop System Polish & Permission Optimization:
• Zero Setup Lag: Eliminated heavy polling loops on the setup/permissions overlay for buttery-smooth 60fps interaction.
• Background Pop-up Permission Flow: Direct OEM redirection (Xiaomi/HyperOS, Vivo, Oppo, Realme) paired with an intuitive step-by-step visual tutorial dialog.
• Welcoming Onboarding: Removed the false 5-minute parent escalation warning during initial setup.
• Clean Anti-Slop UI: Completely eliminated artificial screw rivets from all containers and console panels, elevating the design with sleek obsidian glass and crisp typography.
